The '''Phalanx Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It connected the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] staging [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cormit/Legends|Cormit]]&mdash;located in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] core territory&mdash;with the jungle world [[Tenupe]]&mdash;located in the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]]. It met the [[Vagaari Corridor]] in a T-junction at one end point, Cormit, and passed through several [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] outside of the Ascendancy's core territory&mdash;including [[Catlia]], [[Massoss/Legends|Massoss]] and [[Crustai]]&mdash;before leaving the Unknown Regions<ref name="Atlas" /> and entering Wild Space.<ref name="teaoc">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Phalanx Route first appeared in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], in the map depicting the Chiss Ascendancy's core territory and its immediate vicinity.<ref name="Atlas" />
